notes.title: Zombies vs. Vampires Fest is Live and Update Version 1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
Greetings Cleansers,

The Zombies vs Vampires Fest is now live and Exanimate will be partaking in it. Along side the event as well we will be releasing a content update, nothing screams Vampires like dressing up as one and firing off a bunch of explosives. The changes will be listed below, the update will includes new content, quality of life changes, balance changes and bug fixes.


New Content


	Cosmetics

		Vampire Head

 			For if you want to have the fangs of your vampiric appeal


		Vampire Torso

 			For if you want a fancy cloak akin to a vampire


		Bat Wings

 			For if you have high ambitions of wanting to fly like a vampire



	Weapons

		Standard Grenade Launcher

 			A small grenade launcher that deals no impact damage and has a small weak explosion


		Advanced Grenade Launcher

 			A traditional launcher with greatly increased fire power compared to the previous tier


		Heal-Launcher

 			A modified Standard Grenade Launcher with custom shells designed to heal the living and erode the dead


		Heal-Thrower

 			A modified Flamethrower designed to be much lighter that fires a healing beam that can burn and melt the undead



	Grenades

		Frag Grenades

 			An explosive grenade with a higher explosion radius and pierce but increased fused time and reduced damage



	Starting Items

		Standard Grenade Launcher and Standard Hammer

 			Start the mission with a Standard Grenade Launcher and Standard Hammer

		


Balance Changes


Game Modes

	Skirmish

 		Spawn rate is now increased by 10% for each additional player


	Horde

 		Spawn rate is now increased by 12.5% for each additional player


	Wave

 		Spawn rate is now increased by 12.5% for each additional player



Difficulty

	Calamity

 		Enemy health scaling decreased from 162.5% to 150%



Weapons

	Blunt Gun

 		Ammo increased from 34 to 42
 		Shotgun burst increased from 5 to 6


	Flamethrower

 		Magazine size increased from 75 to 100
 		Backup ammo increased from 375 to 400


	Pump Action Grenade Launcher

 		Renamed to Super Grenade Launcher
 		Tier decreased from 4 to 3
 		Projectile damage decreased from 5 to 4
 		Explosion damage decreased from 10 to 8
 		Reload time increased from 1.25s to 1.5s


	Bow Blade

 		Ammo increased from 45 to 60


	Rail Gun

 		Pierce decreased from 4 to 3



Grenades

	Explosive Grenade

 		Impact damage decreased from 1 to 0.5


	Impact Grenade

 		Impact damage decreased from 2 to 1
 		Explosion damage increased from 10 to 12


	Concussion Grenade

 		Impact damage decreased from 1 to 0.5


	Healing Bomb

 		Impact damage decreased from 1 to 0.5


	B.H. Bomber

 		Is now available to be selected from the Player Setup
 		Fuse time increased from 1.25s to 2.5s
 		Impact damage decreased from 1 to 0.5
 		Points granted for unlocking higher tier weapons decreased from 5 to 1


	Devastating Detonator

 		Is now available to be selected from the Player Setup
 		Fuse time increased from 2.5s to 3.75s
 		Impact damage decreased from 1 to 0.5
 		Points granted for unlocking higher tier weapons decreased from 5 to 1



Vials

	Debuff Vial

 		Healing decreased from 5% to 4%
 		Reduced fire rate increased from 25% to 33%
 		Negative effect now affects melee attack speed



Nomad Buffs

	Nomad Critical Buff

 		Healing increased from 1% to 2%
 		New Effect: Increase critical hit chance by +5% if you do not own the Critical Buff



Zombies
	
	General

 		Major Threats explosion damage resistance now triggers on all explosions, not just grenade explosions


	Twitcher

 		Dodge amount on Epidemic decreased from 2 to 1
 		Dodge amount on Pandemic decreased from 3 to 2
 		Dodge amount on Apocalypse decreased from 4 to 2
 		Dodge amount on Calamity decreased from 5 to 3
 		Dodge cooldown on Outbreak decreased from 3.5s to 2.5s
 		Dodge cooldown on Epidemic decreased from 3s to 2s
 		Dodge cooldown on Pandemic decreased from 2.5s to 2s
 		Dodge cooldown on Apocalypse decreased from 2s to 1.5s
 		Dodge cooldown on Calamity decreased from 2s to 1.5s


	Injector

 		Melee attacks can no longer apply Injector's Venom Debuff if target already has it



Miscellaneous Changes

	Supply Crate

 		Now drops between 0 and 3 gold money when breaking open



Fixes

	Bugs

 		Fixed a pathing exploit down the elevator in Labs
 		Fixed Impact Grenades dealing the incorrect explosion damage
 		Fixed Incendiary Bombs displaying and dealing the incorrect impact damage
 		Fixed Devastating Detonator having the incorrect pierce
 		Fixed players healing each other with Med-Guns while dead
 		Fixed player cosmetic drops not matching the intended cosmetic

notes.title: Hot-Fix Update ! Version 1.0.0.2
notes.notes:
A hot-fix update has been released for Exanimate. This brings the game version up from Version 1.0.0.1 to Version 1.0.0.2.
This update features balance changes, bug and crash fixes.


Weapons

	Advanced Axe

 		Critical hit chance decreased from 5% to 4%


	Super Hammer

 		Pierce decreased from 5 to 4


	Super Axe
		
 Critical hit chance decreased from 10% to 5%


	Chain Whip
		
 Attack speed increased from 0.275 to 0.3


	Heated Blade
	
 	Attack speed decreased from 0.35 to 0.3



Fixes

	Bugs

 		Fixed some missing light particle effects on Labs
 		Potentially fixed a pathing issue in Labs that would significantly reduce spawn times when 
playing with more than 1 player

	Crashes

 		Fixed crash that occurs when unlocking items in the Logbook

notes.title: Hot-Fix Update! Version 1.0.0.1
notes.notes:
A hot-fix update has been released for Exanimate. This brings the game version up from Version 1.0.0.0 to Version 1.0.0.1.
This update features quality of life improvements, balance changes, bug and crash fixes.


Gamemodes

	Horde

 		Horde time for the first horde increased from 150s to 180s


Locations

	Industry

 		The construction in Industry no longer goes down to the center of the earth



Difficulty

	Outbreak

 		Escaped multiplier increased from x0.75 to x1


	Epidemic

 		Escaped multiplier increased from x1 to x1.25


	Pandemic

 		Escaped multiplier increased from x1.25 to x1.5
 		Spawn rate multiplier increased from x0.85 to x1

	
	Apocalypse

 		Nomad Buff shop can now appear
 		Escaped multiplier increased from x1.5 to x2
 		Spawn rate multiplier increased from x0.85 to x1


	Calamity

 		Escaped multiplier increased from x2 to x2.5
 		Spawn rate multiplier increased from x0.85 to x1
 		Calamity buff increment chance when horde becomes aggressive or increases in size decreased from 2.5% to 2%



Weapons

	Shop Unlocking

 		Points required to unlock tier 3 weapons in the shop decreased from 350 to 340
 		Points required to unlock tier 4 weapons in the shop decreased from 800 to 730
 		Points required to unlock tier 5 weapons in the shop decreased from 1500 to 1330


	Standard Med-Gun

 		Healing decreased from 4 to 3


	Advanced Hammer

 		Damage decreased from 5.5 to 5


	Advanced Axe

 		Damage decreased from 7 to 6
 		Stamina consumption increased from 10 to 12.5


	Advanced Med-Gun

 		Healing decreased from 2 to 1.5


	Super Hammer

 		Damage decreased from 8 to 7


	Super Axe

 		Damage decreased from 10 to 8
 		Stamina consumption increased from 10 to 12.5


	Super Med-Gun

 		Healing decreased from 2 to 1.5


	Chain Whip

 		Damage decreased from 8 to 7
 		Pierce decreased from 5 to 3
 		Stamina consumption increased from 7.5 to 10


	Heated Blade

 		Damage decreased from 12 to 8
 		Attack speed increased from 0.25 to 0.35
 		Increased Ignite stacks applied from 1 to 3


	Energy Ninjato

 		Stamina consumption increased from 5 to 7.5
 		Pierce decreased from 3 to 2


	Ripper's Saw Arms

 		Damage decreased from 20 to 14
 		Stamina consumption decreased from 15 to 12.5



Grenades

	Incendiary Bomb

 		Ground fire dropped increased from 3 to 4



Passives

	+50 Stamina Passive

 		Updated the icon to better differentiate from the +10% Kill Income Passive



Buffs

	Critical Buff

 		Daze apply chance no longer ignores enemy daze resist chance


	Penetration Buff

 		Melee weapons and explosions now gain +1 pierce


	Stamina Buff

 		Updated the icon to better differentiate from the Money Buff



Support

	Sniper Turret

 		Accuracy increased from 97.5% to 99%



Zombies

	General

 		Zombies now enrage after being alive for too long
                Every 2 minutes a zombie is alive they gain double move speed and acceleration
                This effect does not apply to Major Threat


 		Zombie upgrade chance decreased to 0% across all difficulty levels
 		Zombie upgrade chance now increases when the horde becomes more aggressive or increases in size, except on Outbreak difficulty
 		Elite spawn chance on Outbreak during max aggression decreased from 10% to 0%
 		Zombie downgrade chance now decreases when the horde becomes more aggressive or increases in size with the exception of Super Threats on Outbreak difficulty
 		Daze resist chance no longer decreases while the Daze Debuff is still applied



	Limper

 		Removed Injector from upgrade list
 		Added Blade to upgrade list


	Rabid

 		Removed Spewer from upgrade list
 		Added Stray Creeper to upgrade list


	Lard

 		Removed Twitcher from upgrade list
 		Added Bio-Zombie to upgrade list


	Grappler

 		Added Stray Creeper to upgrade list


	Ghost

 		Removed Stray Creeper from upgrade list
 		Added Blade and Bio-Zombie to upgrade list


	Burster

 		Added Stray Creeper to upgrade list


	Twitcher

 		Now plays a sound effect when performing its special attack
 		Will no longer attempt to pin targets above or below it
 		Now deals damage upon initially pouncing target
 		Dodge chance increased to 100% across all difficulties
 		Now has limited amount of dodges that can be performed on the following difficulties:
  			                                               -Outbreak: 1
  			-Epidemic: 2
  			-Pandemic: 3
  			-Apocalypse: 4
  			-Calamity: 5


 		Cooldown now grants back 1 dodge
 		Dodge cooldown on Pandemic increased from 2s to 2.25s
 		Dodge cooldown on Apocalypse increased from 1.5s to 2s
 		Dodge cooldown on Calamity increased from 1s to 2s


	Spewer/ Volley Spewer

 		Projectile now ignores platforms
 		Will now attempt to shoot players through barricades


	Injector

 		Now deals 50% damage upon initially grabbing target
 		Will no longer attempt to grab targets above or below it


	Twin Blade

 		Now plays a sound effect when performing its special attack
 		Will no longer attempt to lunge at targets above or below it


	Bio-Zombie

 		Removed ability to enrage on higher difficulties in favour of newly introduced global zombie enrage mechanic


	Inferno

 		Flamethrower projectile now ignores platforms


	Assassin

 		Now deals 20% damage upon initially grabbing target
 		Will no longer attempt to grab targets above or below it



Debuffs

	Injector's Venom

 		Will now reduce the duration by 30 seconds if applied to a target that already has Injector's Venom


	Snare

 		Duration decreased from 4s to 3s
 		Additional duration per stack decreased from +1s to +0.75s



Other Changes

	Player

 		Players can now press the shoot button to perform active reloads


	Vault

 		Added all items that are unlocked by default to the Vault so players can view them without the risk of being snuck up on


	UI/UX

 		Changed player health text from yellow to green
 		Adjusted alignment of health text
 		Removed player crosshair (Accuracy indicator is still present)



Fixes

	Bugs

 		Fixed typo on +10% Kill Income passive
 		Fixed Ripper log giving incorrect health stat
 		Fixed missing and incorrectly placed tiles at the Pit
 		Fixed Bridge location log despawning after 2 minutes
 		Fixed a pathing exploit near the secret area at the Bridge
 		Fixed exit button in shop displaying the wrong button for keyboard/ mouse users
 		Fixed shop evacuation drone sound still playing after it leaves
 		Fixed the "Lard Trophy" and "Raining Body Parts" achievement not progressing if the Giblets setting was turned off
 		Fixed dead bodies disappearing if Giblet setting was turned off
 		Fixed players not being able to escape Assassin grabs while they have the Daze Debuff
 		Fixed a pathing exploit along the elevator shaft in Labs
 		Fixed a pathing exploit inside the side towers in City
 		Fixed outdated logbook data 
 Fixed data not updating in the logbook
 Fixed mouse control not working in the shop Special and Inventory tab while playing as player 2, 3 or 4


	Crashes

 		Fixed crash when attempting to melee with shoot button while not having a melee weapon

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes: TO prepare for the upcoming release, the demo has been updated to better reflect how the final release will play like. It will feature some new toys to play with as well as some new game mechanics and bug fixes.

notes.title: Exanimate Release Date!
notes.notes:
Greetings up and coming Cleansers!

The distant hordes of the Exanimate are beginning to grow restless. They hunger for the flesh of the living and strive to convert all those who oppose them. We need fresh Cleansers to help purge the endless hordes of what remains of humanity.

Therefore we are happy to announce that Exanimate will be releasing on February 28th 2025 at 7:00 AM PST.

We are very excited to get the game into your hands, see what item combos and strategies players will come up with and most importantly, see players having fun with classic split-screen co-op action.

We thank you for your patients!

-CodeCabanaGames
